attachments.origin_landmark: distal two-thirds of the lateral surface of the fibular shaft (deep to fibularis longus)

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Shorter, deeper, and more distal in origin than fibularis longus, whose tendon it shares a common synovial sheath with behind the lateral malleolus.
functional_compartments.source: Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset

motor_endplate_zones.method: cadaveric dissection of the superficial fibular nerve's motor entry point (MEP)
motor_endplate_zones.notes: Mean reference line length 33.4 +/- 2.5 cm across 43 cadaveric legs. The nerve branch to fibularis brevis itself leaves the superficial fibular nerve trunk at approximately 28% along this line, then enters the muscle within the 40-60% band reported here.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Lee JH, Lee BN, An X, Chung RH, Kwon SO, Han SH (2011), Clinical Anatomy 24(2):232-236, doi:10.1002/ca.21076 (https://doi.org/10.1002/ca.21076) -- retrieved via PubMed

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998); Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset
